# Entity resolution calibration

<!-- Generated by `neonradar er calibrate --size large --seed 20261026` (PHASE-2.md M2.10b). Do not edit by hand: run the command again. -->

The large synthetic entity resolution benchmark (seed 20261026, M2.9) was scored once by the two Splink models down to a match probability of 0.50, and the constrained clustering of PHASE-2.md 7.1.6 then ran again on the stored pairs for each threshold `t` below, without scoring again. The measures are those of PHASE-2.md 7.1.7: pairwise precision and recall of each class with `merge_threshold = t` for both models, the hard negatives merged at that threshold, and the recall of policy-blocked true pairs (P1, P2) as possible matches with `candidate_threshold = t` and the merge thresholds of `er.yaml`, each raised to `t` when it is lower (the clustering drops every pair below the candidate threshold, so a candidate threshold above a merge threshold in effect raises it). Under operator decision OD-27 the policy-blocked recall counts only true pairs with no name-only record, as the `er bench` gate does: a name-only record holds names and at most a country, with no birth date, postcode, linked organisation or identifier (a person) and no registration number, incorporation year or postcode (an organisation). The policy-blocked true pairs with a name-only record are reported in the last column; that figure neither gates nor proposes a value. Person-organisation pairs merged are pairs of records whose truth classes differ, in one cluster, with `merge_threshold = t` and with `candidate_threshold = t`; precision and recall leave them out, so a row with any of them never passes the rule below. Every resolvable record has a truth row and every truth row a record in the run (`er calibrate` stops otherwise). Pairs below 0.50 were not scored, so the table says nothing about lower thresholds.

Libraries: duckdb 1.5.6, pyarrow 26.0.0, splink 5.0.0. Comparisons generated by blocking: person 58355, organisation 11185. Pairs scored at 0.50 or more: person model 15914, organisation model 9053. One DuckDB thread, training seed 20261026.

## Proposed values

The rule of PHASE-2.md 7.1.7: for each class the lowest merge threshold whose precision is at least 0.98, and the highest candidate threshold whose policy-blocked recall (OD-27: the pairs with no name-only record) is at least 0.9, among the rows with no person-organisation pair merged. A proposed candidate threshold above a merge threshold means raising that merge threshold to it as well.

| Setting | Proposed | In er.yaml now |
|---|---|---|
| `merge_threshold.person` | 0.998 | 0.99 |
| `merge_threshold.org` | 0.5 | 0.995 |
| `candidate_threshold` | none passes | 0.8 |

`er calibrate` never edits `resolve/config/er.yaml`. The tech lead and the graph mentor choose the values at the freeze and record them, with this table, in ADR-0014. The thresholds come from the synthetic benchmark only: no real pair is labelled before the evaluation sample is drawn (G10, PHASE-2.md 7.3).
